Host Status Output
{escape(hostname)} {"OK" if status == 0 else "FAILED"} {escape(output)}
""" try: with open('report.html', 'w') as f: f.write(html_content) except IOError: sys.stderr.write("Failed to write report.html\n") sys.exit(1) def generate_log(hostnames, results): with open('run.log', 'a') as f: for hostname, status, _ in results: f.write(f"{hostname} {'OK' if status == 0 else 'FAILED'}\n") def main(): try: hostnames = [] for line in sys.stdin: line = line.strip() if line: hostnames.append(line) if not hostnames: sys.stderr.write("No hostnames provided\n") sys.exit(1) results = [] with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor: future_to_host = {executor.submit(run_ping, hostname): hostname for hostname in hostnames} for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(future_to_host): hostname = future_to_host[future] try: result = future.result() results.append(result) except Exception as e: sys.stderr.write(f"Error processing {hostname}: {e}\n") results.append((hostname, -1, f"Error: {e}")) generate_report(hostnames, results) generate_log(hostnames, results) except Exception: sys.stderr.write("Error reading stdin\n") sys.exit(1) if __name__ == "__main__": main()
